title: CNT encapsulated nickel-doped hollow porous manganese oxide scaffold as a sulfur cathode host for Li–S battery applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2668-2683
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07700H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Arunakumari Nulu, Venugopal Nulu, Hee Cheol Kim, Keun Yong Sohn
The novel hollow porous structures of Ni-doped MnO2 encapsulated with multi-walled carbon nanotubes (CNTs) used as an efficient host for a sulfur cathode, which showed excellent electrochemical properties with faster Li+ diffusion properties.
